requirement: v3.1.0: the Fang queue journal is ported to W2M as @twinsearth/w2m-dsh-plugin/queue-journal (store + four /api/w2m/composer/* routes + composer dock client UI in the single client bundle) and its tests pass

assertions.store: ComposerJournal is copied verbatim from Fang (src/queue-journal/lib/composer-journal.mjs); its data directory defaults to $DSH_HOME/xclient/queue-journal
assertions.routes: GET/POST /api/w2m/composer/journal, GET /api/w2m/composer/journal/history and POST /api/w2m/composer/queue are registered on the connection fetch registry; the restore route answers session-not-live (409) when no live agent can take the rows, exactly as the Fang route did
assertions.client: createQueueJournalModule() in lib/client.js is the Fang factory body with only the auth-token shim and /fang/api -> /api/w2m rewrites; the root apply(ctx) mounts it on conversation.composer.dock, so the draft/queue journal UI appears in the composer dock
assertions.suites: queue-journal 4/4 and client bundle 36/36 (the seat expectation now lists 17 seats including conversation.composer.dock)
assertions.artifact: scripts/pack.mjs packs dist/twinsearth-w2m-dsh-plugin-3.1.0.tgz deterministically; the published sha256 is the one release.yml writes into dist/SHA256SUMS, so the record does not restate the hash of the archive that contains it
